classes.name: local_measurement_summary
classes.definition: A compact statement derived from local clock/discipline observation, without exporting raw samples or the clock algorithm.

classes.name: authenticated_source_claim
classes.definition: A source claim whose source identity or channel was authenticated before local assessment.

classes.name: unauthenticated_source_claim
classes.definition: A source claim observed without identity/channel authentication strong enough for the consuming profile.

classes.name: source_diversity_summary
classes.definition: A compact evaluator summary of timing-source dependency diversity and common-mode risk, without exporting source identifiers, paths, raw observations, or clock-selection algorithms.
notes: May support source_diversity_posture obligations but is still summary-only and not a provenance graph.

classes.name: operator_configuration
classes.definition: A local configuration fact, such as selected profile, applicability map, validity scope, or policy reference.

classes.name: profile_catalog_rule
classes.definition: A normative rule from the assessed profile catalog, including required/default items and fallback maps.

classes.name: validity_horizon_summary
classes.definition: A compact evaluator summary of the profile-assessment validity window and current-actionability decision, without treating export time as fresh timing evidence.
notes: May support validity_horizon obligations and replay review.
Does not by itself prove freshness, source correctness, or continued real-world validity after evaluated_at.

classes.name: local_policy_rule
classes.definition: A local policy rule used after historical profile assessment to decide present acceptability or actionability.

classes.name: external_evidence_reference
classes.definition: An opaque pointer or salted commitment binding a redacted evidence item to an external retained record, without interpreting the external record as TimeSync provenance.
notes: May bind a redacted summary item to material held outside TimeSync.
Cannot by itself satisfy a profile obligation or upgrade traceability, freshness, source diversity, or actionability.

classes.name: authorized_verifier_disclosure
classes.definition: A detached authorized-verifier challenge result or receipt confirming that redacted salted-commitment material was reviewed outside ordinary TimeSync exchange, without carrying the salt/preimage in an ordinary evidence summary.
notes: May document that an authorized disclosure review occurred for a redacted commitment.
Cannot by itself satisfy or upgrade traceability, freshness, source diversity, profile conformance, or current actionability.

classes.name: replay_transparency_receipt
classes.definition: A detached replay-transparency receipt or aggregate verifier audit summary showing that challenge-result replay was logged or summarized, without exposing verifier rosters, salts, preimages, legal-authority detail, or external provenance semantics.
notes: May support review of replay visibility and aggregate verifier activity.
Cannot satisfy or upgrade traceability, freshness, source diversity, profile conformance, current actionability, or TimeSync provenance.

classes.name: witness_cohort_summary
classes.definition: A compact detached summary of witness-checkpoint or monitor-cohort posture for replay-transparency review, without exporting witness/monitor rosters, identities, proof material, gossip transcripts, or external provenance semantics.
notes: May support review of replay visibility and split-view posture only.
Cannot satisfy or upgrade traceability, freshness, source diversity, profile conformance, current actionability, or TimeSync provenance.

classes.name: transparency_trust_policy_reference
classes.definition: A digest-bound reference to external transparency trust-policy rules for anchor freshness, checkpoint consistency, witness thresholds, monitor-cohort minimums, or cross-operator replay-visibility threshold equivalence, without exporting the trust-policy language, trust anchors, witness rosters, monitor identities, or external provenance semantics.
notes: May bind replay-transparency or aggregate verifier audit posture to external local policy rules.
Cannot satisfy or upgrade profile evidence, source traceability, current actionability, profile conformance, transparency provenance, or verifier authorization.

classes.name: lifecycle_authority_rotation_summary
classes.definition: A compact summary of transparency trust-policy lifecycle-authority rotation, delegated status-publication posture, or compromise-response state, without exporting authority rosters, key material, delegation chains, forensics, repository topology, or external provenance semantics.
notes: May constrain replay-visibility evaluation for a transparency trust-policy reference.
Cannot satisfy or upgrade TimeState, profile evidence, source traceability, validity horizon, actionability, verifier authorization, or TimeSync provenance.

classes.name: lifecycle_authority_recovery_attestation
classes.definition: A compact digest-bound reference to a lifecycle-authority compromise recovery attestation or historical/contested replay-visibility disposition, without exporting authority rosters, key material, incident forensics, legal authority details, or external provenance semantics.
notes: May distinguish recovered-current, historical-only, contested, or unknown replay visibility after lifecycle-authority compromise.
Cannot satisfy or upgrade TimeState, profile evidence, source traceability, validity horizon, actionability, verifier authorization, or TimeSync provenance.

classes.name: recovery_audit_rollup_summary
classes.definition: A compact aggregate summary of compromise-era suppression and lifecycle-authority recovery-audit rollup posture, without exporting incident identifiers, affected challenge-result identifiers, authority identities, verifier identities, forensics, legal-authority details, or external provenance semantics.
notes: May constrain aggregate replay-review posture for a reporting period that overlaps a lifecycle-authority compromise or recovery window.
Cannot satisfy or upgrade TimeState, profile evidence, source traceability, validity horizon, actionability, verifier authorization, or TimeSync provenance.

classes.name: aggregate_privacy_control_summary
classes.definition: A compact aggregate-only summary of publication cadence, suppression-threshold equivalence, and statistical-noise posture for replay-transparency aggregate audit summaries, without exporting verifier identities, challenge-result identifiers, privacy-budget internals, noise parameters, cross-publication reconstruction material, or external provenance semantics.
notes: May constrain whether aggregate replay-review rollups are safe to publish or compare across operators and reporting periods.
Cannot satisfy or upgrade TimeState, profile evidence, source traceability, validity horizon, actionability, verifier authorization, individual replay visibility, or TimeSync provenance.

classes.name: aggregate_revision_lineage_summary
classes.definition: A compact aggregate-only summary of correction, withdrawal, supersession, and longitudinal reconciliation lineage for replay-transparency aggregate publications, without exporting suppressed deltas, individual challenge-result identifiers, verifier identities, exact reconstruction material, or external provenance semantics.
notes: May constrain whether an aggregate publication supersedes, corrects, withdraws, or reconciles a prior aggregate publication.

Cannot satisfy or upgrade TimeState, profile evidence, source traceability, validity horizon, actionability, verifier authorization, individual replay visibility, aggregate current visibility, or TimeSync provenance.

classes.name: aggregate_correction_authority_summary
classes.definition: A compact summary of aggregate correction-authority authorization, correction-notification freshness, and correction-chain portability posture, without exporting authority rosters, key material, recipient identities, repository topology, or notification payloads.
notes: May constrain how aggregate correction, withdrawal, supersession, or reconciliation lineage is interpreted.
Cannot satisfy profile obligations or upgrade TimeState, profile conformance, actionability, individual replay visibility, or TimeSync provenance.

classes.name: aggregate_correction_authority_lifecycle_summary
classes.definition: A compact summary of aggregate correction-authority lifecycle, revocation, emergency-withdrawal, and contestation posture, without exporting authority rosters, key material, revocation endpoints, repository topology, incident forensics, legal-process details, emergency-response plans, contestation-party identities, or external provenance semantics.
notes: May constrain whether aggregate correction-authority posture remains current, historical, emergency-withdrawn, contested, or unknown for aggregate interpretation.
Cannot satisfy or upgrade TimeState, profile evidence, source traceability, validity horizon, actionability, verifier authorization, individual replay visibility, or TimeSync provenance.

classes.name: portable_digest_binding_policy_summary
classes.definition: A compact summary or digest-bound reference describing canonical JSON, byte-envelope, and semantic-version binding policy for returned or retained TimeSync objects, without treating that policy as timing evidence or external provenance.
notes: May constrain how digest-bound returned objects are interpreted for portability and replay review.
Cannot satisfy or upgrade TimeState, profile evidence, source traceability, validity horizon, actionability, verifier authorization, or TimeSync provenance.

classes.name: scope_composition_guard_summary
classes.definition: A compact summary or digest-bound reference recording mixed-layer scope-composition decisions across profile drift, discovery downgrade, digest binding, aggregate lifecycle, and transparency-policy surfaces without allowing those decisions to become timing evidence or provenance.
notes: May constrain whether composed compatibility, downgrade, lifecycle, and replay-transparency metadata remains current, historical, suppressed, or metadata-only.

Cannot satisfy or upgrade TimeState, profile evidence, source traceability, validity horizon, actionability, verifier authorization, individual replay visibility, aggregate lifecycle suppression, or TimeSync provenance.

classes.name: retained_prior_assessment
classes.definition: A prior retained TimeSync assessment reused as a record, not as fresh timing evidence.

classes.name: transport_metadata_only
classes.definition: Envelope/carrier metadata such as sent_at, sequence, delivery status, or channel authentication, considered only as carriage context.
notes: May explain carriage integrity but must not be promoted to TimeState freshness, traceability, or conformance.

classes.name: not_observed
classes.definition: The evaluator records that an item was absent, unknown, or deliberately unavailable.

visibility_lanes.name: local_only
visibility_lanes.definition: May be used by the evaluator but is not exported by default.

visibility_lanes.name: requestable
visibility_lanes.definition: May be returned through ordinary flat request/result accounting if supported.

visibility_lanes.name: profile_default
visibility_lanes.definition: Normally visible for a profile because omission would mislead consumers.

visibility_lanes.name: retention_only
visibility_lanes.definition: Exported for retained review/audit boundaries, not ordinary exchange.
